--- funnel.py ---
import csv, sqlite3
STEPS = ["install", "tutorial_complete", "first_match", "purchase"]
PLATFORMS = ["pc", "steamdeck"]
db = sqlite3.connect("file:analytics.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
print("names", db.execute("select name,count(*) from events group by 1").fetchall())
print("orphans", db.execute("select count(*) from events where user_id not in (select user_id from users)").fetchone())
print("null", db.execute("select count(*) from events where user_id is null or ts is null or name is null").fetchone())
print("bad ts", db.execute("select count(*) from events where ts not glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9] [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]'").fetchone())
print("dup rows", db.execute("select count(*) from (select 1 from events group by user_id,name,ts having count(*)>1)").fetchone())
print("multi per step", db.execute("select name,count(*) from (select user_id,name from events group by 1,2 having count(*)>1) group by 1").fetchall())
rows = db.execute(
    "select u.platform, e.user_id, e.name, e.ts from events e join users u using(user_id) "
    "where u.is_test=0 order by e.ts").fetchall()
times = {}
platform_of = {}
for platform, user_id, name, ts in rows:
    platform_of[user_id] = platform
    times.setdefault((user_id, name), []).append(ts)
counts = {(p, s): 0 for p in PLATFORMS for s in STEPS}
for user_id, platform in platform_of.items():
    prev_ts = ""
    for step in STEPS:
        # Rows are ts-sorted, so the first match is the first valid occurrence.
        prev_ts = next((t for t in times.get((user_id, step), []) if t >= prev_ts), None)
        if prev_ts is None:
            break
        counts[platform, step] += 1
with open("funnel.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    w = csv.writer(out, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["platform", "step", "users", "conv_from_prev"])
    for p in PLATFORMS:
        for i, s in enumerate(STEPS):
            prev = counts[p, STEPS[i - 1]] if i else counts[p, s]
            w.writerow([p, s, counts[p, s], f"{(counts[p, s] / prev if prev else 0.0):.4f}"])
